correctness.rationale: The proof reduces a sub-quorum coloring to a quorum coloring of its colored induced complete-multipartite subgraph. For a largest occupied part P with M colored vertices outside it, color classes meeting P require at least ceil((M+1)/2)-1 outside vertices and classes missing P require at least ceil((M+1)/2). With at least three colors, one missing P would exceed the M available outside vertices for M>=2; M=1 is ruled out directly. Hence all colors meet P and q<=|P|<=L. Explicit induced independent-set and K2 constructions attain max{L,2}. Exhaustive verification through order seven checks both the formula and structural assertion.

value.rationale: Complete multipartite graphs are a canonical dense family, and the result gives a full infinite-family classification of a newly studied invariant rather than a routine finite case. The structural all-colors-meet-a-largest-part obstruction explains the exact maximum and reveals a genuine separation from ordinary quorum coloring on published K_{3,3,...,3} examples.
